name: CUTC Montreal
description: Canada's largest undergraduate tech conference comes to Montreal. Canadian Undergraduate Technology Conference 2026 (CUTC 2026: TRANSFORM) brings together 500+ ambitious students, founders, and builders for a high-energy day of talks, networking, and hands-on collaboration centered on AI, startups, and the future of technology. Featuring standout speakers including Harley Finkelstein (President, Shopify), Stefania Pecore (AI Ethics Expert, UNESCO), and Yacine Mahdid (Founder, Axya).
